protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: Confirmed. A class 0/1 ForwardOpen can resolve mixed-class application paths to arbitrary existing CipInstance objects, while CorrectSizes treats endpoint attribute 3 as ByteBuf/CipByteArray. Identity instance 1 attribute 3 is the uint16_t product_code_, so ByteBuf::size reads beyond the actual object; issue #45 documents the reachable TCP ForwardOpen path and ASan global-buffer-overflow, plus the analogous Ethernet Link heap-buffer-overflow.
protocol_checks.atomic_bic: Confirmed as 2d6b8f3eaafde2e6090cf76966b3d338f7e2b4f6. Scoped -S history finds this as the first public write of check_path; the same commit binds later paths by each path's own class and instance and changes I/O size handling to consume those bound instances directly. It is a one-parent non-merge commit and is the smallest surviving public object that introduces the reachable mixed-class type confusion.
protocol_checks.immediate_parent_absence: Confirmed against present parent 0442159a0a1369b0ae7722dc42b2b70c03d3c41e and its tree.
